mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_order( order_id, user_id, team_id, activity_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, source, channel, original_amount, deduction_amount, pay_amount, status, out_trade_no, create_time, update_time ) values( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{activityId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalAmount}, #{deductionAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{outTradeNo}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select id, order_id, user_id, team_id, activity_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, source, channel, original_amount, deduction_amount, pay_amount, status, out_trade_no, create_time, update_time from group_buy_order where user_id = #{userId} and out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} limit 1
select user_id from group_buy_order where team_id = #{teamId}
select out_trade_no from group_buy_order where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 1
